en.explanation:
If f(xy) = f(x) f(y) x, y R and f(0) 0

put x = y = 0

  f(0) = [f(0)]2

  f(0) = 1

put y = 0  f(0) = f(x) f(0)

 f(x) = 1

given that = f(x)

   = 1  y = x + k

given that y(0) = 1

  k = 1

hence y = x + 1

y + y = + = 3
